content:
Sam S: Uploaded the evidence bundle ACME asked for to the vendor S3. Link: https://s3.company/shipments/acme/1902468135-evidence.zip
Maria G: Thanks. Quick summary for ACME: 3 Critical (auth bypass), 5 High (info leak, CVE-2023-XXXX), 9 Moderate. Included POC for the auth bypass.
Devon K: Confirmed the build id and hashes inside. I added checksums in manifest.txt
sec-bot: automated-scan complete. Output: https://scans.company/reports/1902468135.json
Anya R: ACME wants remediation timeline and named owners. Can we commit to dates for the 3 Critical?
Sam S: Proposed timeline: patch + deploy by 2024-06-10, QA by 06-12, retest w/customer 06-14. Is that realistic?
Devon K: For the auth bypass we need owner @Devon K, ETA 06-09 for a hotfix branch. I'll allocate an engineer.
Maria G: I'll take coordination for retest and signed acceptance once ACME runs their verification. Also prepping a high-level mitigation note for their security team.
Anya R: I'll update the SOC2/SIG artifact folder and include the remediation plan snippet.
Sam S: Customer asked for evidence of fixes: need patch diff + test logs and a fresh scan. Devon can you add instructions for how ACME can validate locally?
Devon K: Adding a small script. Paste below:
```
# ACME local confirm
git fetch origin hotfix/acme-auth
./run_smoke_tests.sh --ticket 1902468135
curl -fsS https://internal-ci.company/artifacts/1902468135/test_log.txt
```
Maria G: Also note: for the external vuln-scan we'll request an exception window. I put proposed maintenance 06-11 02:00-04:00 UTC.
Sam S: I'll notify ACME and lock a presales call for 06-15 14:00 PDT to walk through evidence and retest plan.
Anya R: Ownership matrix: Devon - auth fix; Maria - retest + evidence; Sam - customer liaison; Ops - deploy. Need Ops owner.
Devon K: Looping in @Nina-Ops in thread.
Nina-Ops: Ops: can confirm deploy window 06-11 is ok. I'll own deployment and post-deploy validation.
Maria G: One ask from ACME: can we provide CVSS and remediations per finding in CSV. I'll export and attach.
Sam S: Thanks everyone. I'll assemble the packet and share link back to customer with the timeline. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: Note: ticket 1902468135 created, scan severity summary emailed to acme-security@acme.com
Anya R: Final note — add the acceptance criteria for retest: verified exploit fails, regression tests pass, and CVE flagged closed by scanner.
Sam S: Understood. I'll update thread if anything changes.
